\[
N=h^{-1}(U)\cap g^{-1}(V)
\]
is a neighbourhood of $x$ in $\bar A$. Because $x\in\bar A$, the definition of closure gives $N\cap A\ne\varnothing$. Choose $a\in N\cap A$. Then
\[
h(a)=f(a)=g(a),
\]
while $h(a)\in U$ and $g(a)\in V$. Thus the same point belongs to $U\cap V$, contradicting $U\cap V=\varnothing$. Hence $h=g$ on $\bar A$, so $g$ is uniquely determined by $f$.
